Subject: API & product analytics contract alignment — Amplitude / Segment / Mixpanel

Hi team —

We have three separate renewals and overlapping renewal windows coming up for our API analytics (Segment), product analytics (Amplitude) and Mixpanel accounts. To keep implementation and procurement overhead low, we want to evaluate options for:

- aligning renewal dates where feasible
- exploring any multi-product or portfolio discounts
- confirming committed usage tiers (events, MAUs, API ingest) to avoid overage surprises

Action items I’m requesting from each vendor:
- Updated usage report for the trailing 12 months (by product / org) — see attached Amplitude summary for reference.
- Any available consolidated contracting options or bundling discounts if we commit to multi-year / multi-product.
- Draft SOW or pricing schedule that shows tiered pricing and overage terms.

Internal ask: Marcus/Laura — can you confirm procurement constraints (procurement gate dates, PO lead times) so vendors know our window? I’ve attached a checklist to track the asks.

We’re aiming to have a vendor decision memo by Dec 20 so legal can start redlines. Can we set a short sync next week (30 min)?

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Head of Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Ryan / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the proposed 10% multi-product discount. A few clarifications before we book a call:

1) That discount — is it applied to total platform spend (Amplitude + Segment) or only to Amplitude line items when both contracts are signed together? We prefer a portfolio-level discount so procurement credit can be applied across both invoices.
2) Overage mechanics — can you include a monthly smoothing option (average over 3 months) before we migrate tiers? Our traffic patterns are spiky around feature launches.
3) SLO on data export/retention when we request raw event exports for internal reports. We need CSV exports within 48 hours for compliance audits.

We’ll share a short scoping doc before the sync so the technical POC can avoid long discovery on the call. Proposed meeting windows: Dec 7–9 or Dec 13–15 (30 minutes).

Naomi
Head of Platform Partnerships

- Proceed with vendor scoping calls as planned. Prioritize Amplitude negotiation because it has the largest immediate cost exposure.
- Ask both Amplitude and Segment to provide a consolidated SOW with separate line items (so we can purchase independently if needed).
- Request 60-day hold on current pricing (vendor provided) while we finalize redlines.
